title: Playing the flute and piccolo; the tune 'Got good booty'
summary: Barnes first played a small flute on his own and learned one tune, which he describes.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: What kind of flute was that?
Well, it's an ordinary flute. So, this was a six-row. Then again, I picked it.
Like a little tin flute that you stick out in front of you?
Yeah. That's right. A little tin flute.
Not the kind that they play, that Bob Frank played or anything?
Well, no, no. Bob Frank played a pickle. But I had a pickle too. You see?
Did they have keys on it? That's right. Oh, these were real flutes with keys on them. Did you play those with any bands or just by yourself?
No, no. I played them just by myself. Couldn't play nothing worse while I was in no bands.

Well, this flute that you had, it stuck out in front. Is that right? It stuck out in front of you? The flute stuck in front of you. I see. I see. Now, was it made out of metal? The flute? The piccolo, the flute was made out of metal. But the flute was wood. Well, the piccolo was metal and the flute was wood, I see.
No, I mean the piccolo was wood and the flute was metal.
The flute was metal. So that's how I played it. Now, where did you get that? You went and bought that yourself? Well, I been having that. I went and bought that. Yeah.

And I went and got no car, right? It was nine, nine, nine. I believe it was nine, nine. I believe it was nine, nine. And brought the car home and I didn't play nothing on it but one tune. What was the tune? Well, the gospel's booty, so they say. And I played that tune and sing so much in the middle. The mother roll. That was the number one. I remember where it caught a little bit of it.
Yeah, I know. I'm trying to think maybe I remember some more of it. Do you remember the words? Any of the words?
No, I don't remember none of the words. I'm just giving them out of the gut. But, man, it's gone by now.
Sure. She's got good booty, so they say. So they say. And you'd repeat that.

And you'd repeat it over and over and over and over until the boy, like my uncle said. And he and me, he calls back. People on the other side. Right there. So I had a friend of mine that had that. Sitting there. With a car. So sitting on him, he says, So much got good booty, so they say. He come over to me and he say, What you got? Because I'm going to buy a coin. He went to buy a coin and they went to play it until he got it. And me and him went to get him to run us out the house. And all that. And that was it.
